_schema.basis: traceability: the committee analysis in raw/, engine metadata recorded in pe/<bundle>.json, or the campaign module

annotations.text: FTB states a revenue change for a State fiscal year (July to June). PolicyEngine computes the tax year whose returns are filed in that fiscal year (fiscal 2025-26 from tax year 2025): the YCTC is refundable and is paid when returns are filed. Timing effects inside the year are not modelled.
annotations.basis: FISCAL EFFECT paragraphs in raw/ ('revenue losses of ... in fiscal year (FY) 2025-26'); pipeline/campaign_us/ca_fiscal_notes.py (module docstring)

annotations.text: PolicyEngine's value is static, with no behavioural response. The committee analysis does not state FTB's method.
The estimate is for the bill as introduced. FTB re-estimates each amended version, so a later version's fiscal note can differ.
annotations.basis: version line of each analysis in raw/ ('As Introduced February 3, 2025'; 'As Introduced February 3, 2026')

annotations.text: PolicyEngine's baseline YCTC is $643 million in tax year 2025, against FTB's reported $413 million for tax year 2023. A baseline about 1.5 times FTB's scales the cost of any expansion of the credit.
annotations.basis: sources/ca-fiscal-notes/pe/us-6.2.1.json (baseline ca_yctc, 2025); reform-validation registry claim 9eda40b94ca5ce924e04 (ca_admin, state_ca_yctc: CA FTB, California EITC / YCTC / FYTC Report, Oct 2025, Table 1 p. 8)
